description: This file declares an abstract class `CvdCommandHandler` that defines an interface for handling commands within the Cuttlefish host command framework. It includes virtual methods for checking command handling capability, executing commands, listing subcommands, and providing help information.

classes.name: CvdCommandHandler
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for command handling, including methods for execution, listing, and help support.

methods.name: CanHandle
methods.description: Checks if the handler can handle a given command request.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the command associated with the request.

methods.name: CmdList
methods.description: Returns a list of subcommands that this handler can handle.

methods.name: SummaryHelp
methods.description: Provides a brief summary of the command's purpose, used for help text.

methods.name: ShouldInterceptHelp
methods.description: Indicates whether help command should be intercepted.

methods.name: DetailedHelp
methods.description: Provides detailed help information for the command.
